name: WPI telescoping
full_name: WPI MQP robotic platform for telescoping neurointerventional catheters (proof of concept)
group: Worcester Polytechnic Institute, undergraduate MQP team (advisors Y. Zheng, Z. Zhang)
versions: 2024 MQP report; builds on earlier WPI MQP guidewire robots (stepper-and-solenoid design; BLDC roller design) described in its background
devices_driven: modular telescoping catheters of several sizes
translation_detail: friction-roller (driven and support wheels on a board; 3-wheel, straight and S-shaped layouts tested)
rotation_detail: the whole wheel board rotates through a gear and slip ring (BLDC motors with FOC drivers)
haptics_leader: N.R. (micro-ROS over Wi-Fi, EM sensor integration)
validation_detail: several 3-D-printed prototypes built and iterated; qualitative tests only
